description: This file defines the 'Last' class, which implements the TransformOperator interface to represent a 'last' operation in a clinical data querying context. It provides a string representation and a usage example in comments.

classes.name: Last
classes.description: A class representing the 'Last' operator used for retrieving the latest subset of results in a data query.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to return the string 'LAST', representing the operator as a string.
